column1: # Per RELEASED version core.md §13.5 commits to a git tag and a runnable
# engine page, "neither ever rewritten". This file is what "never rewritten"
# is checked against: one row per archived file, hashed at release.
# APPEND ONLY. A row is written once, by `node tools/archive-check.js --write
# <release>`, and never edited afterwards. If the bytes on disk stop matching
# a row, the bytes are wrong, not the row. `node tools/archive-check.js`
# (gate:archive) fails on modification, on deletion, and on an unlisted file
# What is archived, and why each:
#   archive/<X.Y>/figdown.html   the engine as USERS RAN IT for that release —
#                                the published artifact, not the source engine
#                                at the tag. Only that file reproduces the
#   read/<X.Y>/**.md             the reading contract for language `figdown
#                                X.Y`. The language version is frozen, so what
#                                it means is frozen with it; a later release
#                                writes read/<X.Y+1>/ rather than editing this.
